title: Choose the program composition
question: The roll assigned Tote overlay. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Visual world stays the racing form; this pick is how the full field and the horse sheet sit together.

options.label: Tote overlay
options.lineage: Daily Racing Form tote: columns you sort, a horse you pull
options.thesis: The field is a tote: the filters are the columns, and a horse opens as a side condition sheet.
options.viewport: Masthead, then a conditions bar of invert chips (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, AGE, CREATED, PNL, TVL). Full-bleed agate table of horses. Clicking WARDEN slides a Hot Sheet overlay from the right: call-scale name, past performances, TVL filling toward max, last backer line, deposit stamp. The list stays visible on the left.
options.risk: A column grid can read as a spreadsheet if the overlay does not own the horse at call scale.

raised.raise: TVL-to-max is a filling ruled ink bar, not a percentage caption.
Overlay purse and PnL sit at call-scale, not buried in agate.
The overlay is addressable on this URL; closing it is back, and the filters reprint in place.

options.label: Condition overlay
options.lineage: Overnight program plus the two-page condition book, used to back
options.thesis: The field stays a program; opening a horse opens the same two-page book as entering, but to back it.
options.viewport: Masthead. Left ~45%: stacked program entries (number, silks, name, one PP line, purse, status) with filter chips above. Right overlay: two-page mini book — left PP, TVL progress, last backer; right BACK THIS HORSE slip and stamp.
options.risk: Recasts /enter; a depositor may think they are nominating.

options.label: Carbon overlay
options.lineage: Clerk original with a carbon dropped on the selected entry
options.thesis: The list is the original; the selected horse's sheet drops on as a carbon, still on this page.
options.viewport: Masthead, conditions bar, full-width overnight rows. Selecting a horse lays a Hot Sheet carbon over the lower-right of the same sheet: name, PP, TVL bar, last backer, stamp. The list peeking underneath is the original.
options.risk: Overlay-on-list can feel like a popup if the carbon does not share rules with the entries.
